Although the constitutive expression of Renilla luciferase means that its expression will not be impacted by the changes you implement in each of your cell samples, it does not mean that the levels of Renilla luciferase will be identical in each of your different cell samples.  This is because the amount of Renilla luciferase expressed will depend on the amount of mRNA transcribed and the efficiency of translation, both of which can vary between different cell samples.  Hence, you can still use the normalisation method to normalise your Firefly luciferase readings, but you will need to calculate the normalisation factor for each of your different cell samples.
